scope: Four one-at-a-time HL/SR filters on frozen R01-08, plus four original-Bollinger-without-CMF interaction controls. Research-only; no live or ladder change.
selectionDisclosure: H00 context and archived trade outcomes were already inspected. Predicates are frozen before H01 replay, not an untouched holdout. No subsequent threshold grid.

conditions.predicate: taker15(T) < taker15(T-15m); both healthy. Strict ratio decline, no absolute sell threshold.
conditions.mechanism: Selling is strengthening relative to buying; may still be buy-dominant, not proof of net selling.
Bid/ask balance deteriorating, not necessarily already ask-heavy.

conditions.predicate: native OI1h percentage change >= 0; current/anchor healthy.
conditions.mechanism: Participation not shrinking during the price breakdown; OI alone does not identify long versus short build.

conditions.predicate: Both completed5m closes ending T-5m and T < support frozen at T-15m * (1-0.001). No known prior support => false, not missing OHLC.
conditions.mechanism: Price is below a previously known support with two closed observations, not merely approaching support.

readiness: For each condition and base, replace ONLY that condition's predicate by true; preserve base CMF predicate. Missing source remains missing. SR absence is false condition but healthy readiness if both candle histories are healthy.
qualitySource: Exactly H00 quality card; no relaxed sample or age thresholds under delivery stress.
arrivalModel: Shift each HL raw record availableAt by extraArrivalDelay, then ceil to UTC minute eligibility. Keep original source/event times, T-anchored flow windows and age limits. Apply consistently at T, T-15m and OI anchor T-1h. Do not slide window to T-delay, backfill from late rows, queue rejected signals, or delay candles/SR. SR negative control identical at all HL arrival lags.
timing: Closed4h Bollinger and closed1h CMF available at original signal T. Freeze decision once; enter T+fillDelay, timeout entry+12h then same exit delay. Exit due before new same-timestamp opportunity. One position/pending entry maximum.

screens.recentOnly: For each lag, both execution delays: n>=10, positive net/stress, solvent, every marked month >=-320 versus original Bollinger, own indicator baseline and own readiness. Profit delta>=200 versus own baseline AND readiness; DD no worse than either. Extra-lag stability reported separately; a no-trade abstention is not a profitable qualifier.
screens.fullHistory: Unavailable for new HL rules; no full-profit, defensive or strict-clock qualifier can be awarded. Keep old R01 failures unchanged.
screens.defenseDiagnostics: Retention, losing dollars, DD and exposure-scaled readiness benchmark reported; cannot satisfy inherited full-history defense screen.

reporting: All eight definitions, baseline-first W/L and dollars; both fills and all lags; own-readiness baseline; monthlies for every rule; lost winners/avoided losers and replacement identities/net; source-health abstentions separate from condition; stress/DD/concentration; no filtered-ledger PnL.
nextBoundary: Complete H01 evidence checkpoint. Do not implement or unpause live shorts, change ladder, add extra predicates, commit or push.
